name: Christian Krauter
heading: Hi, I'm Chris Krauter
intro: I am a Ph.D. Candidate in Human-Computer Interaction (Computer Science) in the HCI group of VISUS at the University of Stuttgart, and a member of IMPRS-IS, and SimTech.
paragraphs: My research interest lies in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) with a focus on mobile devices of the future. I am further interested in information visualization and Augmented and Virtual Reality (AR/VR).

I completed my Bachelor’s degree in media informatics, followed by a Master’s degree in computer science, both at the University of Stuttgart. My previous work covered notification placement in VR (bachelor thesis), an immersive social distancing VR demo, and a smart chair for sitting posture recognition and feedback (master thesis).
Please contact me if you are interested in thesis writing or collaboration opportunities or have any questions about my research. I look forward to hearing from you.
